text:
margo: Quick sync — we need to lock launch criteria for the new 'Performance Plus' add-on (priority-lane + 99.9 SLA) before sprint planning tomorrow. Who can weigh in?

dan: I'm around. main tradeoffs: cost buckets vs committed throughput. customers want predictable latency, not just best-effort.

raj: Agree. we should require a) 3 pilot customers signed, b) telemetry for 2 weeks showing p95 < 120ms under pilot load, and c) autoscaler built for dedicated pools.

sophia: +1 on telemetry. also need a fallback policy defined in contract if we miss SLA — credits vs downgrade path. legal wants clear cap on liability.

beth: On pricing: is this an add-on SKU or a higher tier? If addon, we need soft limits and an overflow price. If tier, migration path is harder for existing customers.

margo: Thinking addon SKU with two flavors: Priority-Lane (per-minute priority queues) and Throughput-Reserve (committed slots). Both optional. Launch only if the pilot shows clear delta in p95.

dan: For rollout gating, propose these metrics: pilot_count >= 3, p95_improvement >= 25% vs baseline, cost_per_token_delta < 2x, and no high-severity incidents in 14d.

raj: Can we add a telemetry gating signal for cache-hit-rate? priority lane only helps if cache hit < 60% or bursty sequences. Otherwise benefits are marginal.

sophia: Legal asks we include a 30-day cure period in contracts before credits apply. also require customers to run canary for 72h on their routes.

beth: Pricing sketch: Priority-Lane: $X/hr + 10% markup on tokens for served priority traffic. Throughput-Reserve: committed monthly slots, discount vs on-demand. We need a rough model to show revenue vs expected utilization.

margo: I'll take owner for definition doc. action: beth to produce 2 pricing models (addon vs tier) by EOD Wed. dan to draft gating checklist and rollout playbook. raj to run telemetry queries for three largest pilot candidates. sophia to sync with legal on cure and liability wording.

deploy-bot: reminder: feature-flag "perf-plus-priority" will be created in staging after doc merged.

dan: Draft gating checklist (early):
```
- pilot_count >= 3
- pilot_duration >= 14d
- p95 < 120ms and >= 25% improvement
- cache_hit_rate < 60% or burstness_score > 0.6
- cost_per_effective_token delta acceptable
- rollout runbook approved by eng-sre
- contract cure period = 30d
```

raj: I'll run the cache/burstness queries today and share results in #eng-metrics. quick note: we should include a telemetry signal for tail QPS per model too.

sophia: Legal: we can accept 99.9 SLA with credit formula capped at 3 months' fees and a 30d cure. want to make sure support escalation path is documented.

beth: Pricing models will include utilization scenarios: 30/60/90% utilization. will include sample TCO for customers and margin for us.

margo: Final launch criteria proposal: must hit all gating checklist items + contract template approved. if any item fails, we hold and run another 2-week pilot. Decision point: Sprint planning tomorrow 10:30am — bring final numbers.

dan: I'll put the gating checklist PR up before EOD. can someone from eng-sre review? @raj?

raj: Yup, i'll review the runbook and telemetry queries. ping me when PR is ready.

sophia: I'll draft the contract clause and post in this thread. small ask: add a line that customers must opt into observability retention addon if they want SLA-level tracing — otherwise we can't guarantee forensic timelines.

margo: Noted. last thing: can we prepare a short customer-facing one-pager describing benefits, limits, and escape hatches? beth + dan please pair on that.

beth: on it. will drop a draft by tomorrow morning.

margo: Thanks all — I'll consolidate and post an agenda for the 10:30 sync. :thumbsup:
